description: Master definition the webapp reads to know, for every template, all the questions to ask the user. Frontend grid + questionnaire + document preview are all driven by this file.
disclaimer: All content is a demo draft, not legal advice, and is not lawyer-reviewed. Must be reviewed for the chosen jurisdiction before real use.

commonQuestions.label: Which country/state's law applies?
commonQuestions.helpText: The law that governs this document and where disputes are settled.

commonQuestions.label: What date should the document take effect?
commonQuestions.helpText: Usually today or the signing date.

commonQuestions.label: First party's full legal name
commonQuestions.helpText: Company name (with entity type, e.g. Pvt Ltd) or individual's full name.

commonQuestions.label: Who signs for the first party?
commonQuestions.helpText: Name and title of the person signing.

commonQuestions.label: Who signs for the second party?

documentTypes.name: Mutual NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement)
documentTypes.shortDescription: Both parties protect each other's confidential information.

questions.label: What are the parties working on together?
questions.helpText: e.g. exploring a partnership, a pilot project. This becomes the allowed 'Purpose'.

questions.label: How many years should the agreement last?
How long must information stay confidential after it ends?

documentTypes.name: Independent Contractor Agreement
documentTypes.shortDescription: Engage a freelancer or contractor for a defined scope.

questions.label: What work will the contractor do?
Will the contractor create work/IP (code, designs, content)?
Who owns the created work?
options: Contractor keeps ownership, licenses to client

questions.label: Confidentiality lasts how many years after the work ends?

documentTypes.name: Non-Competition Agreement (NCA)
documentTypes.shortDescription: Restricts a person from competing with the company.

jurisdictionWarnings.IN: Post-employment non-compete clauses are generally UNENFORCEABLE in India under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Flag for legal review; do not present as enforceable.

documentTypes.name: Terms of Service (Website)
documentTypes.shortDescription: Generic terms of service for a website or app.

questions.label: Do you charge users / take payments?

howTheAppUsesThis.1_grid: Render the template grid (reference image 1) from documentTypes[]: card title=name, subtitle=shortDescription, grouped by category.
howTheAppUsesThis.2_questionnaire: When a template is chosen, the questionnaire = its usesCommonQuestions (resolved from commonQuestions[]) + its own questions[], asked one at a time. Hide any question whose visibleWhen condition is not met.
howTheAppUsesThis.3_reuse: Answers are keyed by fieldId. Common fieldIds (e.g. party_a_name) carry across templates so the user is never asked twice.
howTheAppUsesThis.4_validation: Enforce required + validation rules server-side before generating. Block generation on missing/invalid fields.
howTheAppUsesThis.5_generation: Replace each mapsTo placeholder in placeholderTemplate with the matching answer. Then scan for any leftover {{...}} before showing the draft.
howTheAppUsesThis.6_preview: Live document preview (reference image 2, right pane) re-renders as answers come in; AI chat (left pane) explains clauses and proposes additions, which stay 'proposed' until the user approves.
howTheAppUsesThis.7_jurisdiction_guard: If a documentType has a jurisdictionWarning for the chosen jurisdiction, show it and flag for review; if the jurisdiction isn't in the documentType's jurisdiction[], mark UNSUPPORTED instead of generating.
